# Temple Scroll Column 41 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 11QT (Cave 11), Col. 41 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**41:1** And any person who touches the surface of an open vessel upon which there is no fitting cover fastened — it is unclean.

**41:2** And everything that is in the vessel shall be unclean; and any food upon which water comes shall be unclean.

**41:3** And every earthen vessel into which any of these things falls — everything that is in it shall be unclean, and you shall break it.

**41:4** And ovens and stoves shall be torn down; they are unclean and shall be unclean to you.

**41:5** Nevertheless, a spring or a cistern, a gathering of waters — it shall be clean; but whoever touches a carcass in it shall be unclean.

**41:6** And anyone in the open field who touches one slain by the sword, or a dead body, or a human bone, or a grave — he shall be unclean seven days.

**41:7** And they shall bring for the unclean person a red heifer without blemish, in which there is no defect, and upon which a yoke has never come.

**41:8** And you shall give it to Eleazar the priest, and he shall bring it outside the camp, and it shall be slaughtered before him.

**41:9** And Eleazar the priest shall take of its blood with his finger and sprinkle it toward the front of the tent of meeting seven times.

**41:10** And the heifer shall be burned in his sight — its hide and its flesh and its blood, with its dung, he shall burn.

**41:11** And they shall take for the unclean person some of the ashes of the burning of the sin offering, and living water shall be put upon them in a vessel.

**41:12** And a clean person shall take hyssop and dip it in the water and sprinkle it upon the tent and upon all the vessels.

**41:13** And upon the persons who were there, and upon him who touched the bone or the slain one or the dead body or the grave.

**41:14** And the clean person shall sprinkle upon the unclean on the third day and on the seventh day; and he shall purify him on the seventh day.

**41:15** And he shall wash his garments and bathe in water, and at evening he shall be clean.

**41:16** And the man who is unclean and does not purify himself — that person shall be cut off from the midst of the assembly, for he has defiled the sanctuary of the LORD.

---

*EMET notes: Column 41 continues the corpse impurity regulations from Column 40 and introduces the red heifer rite (cf. Numbers 19:1-22). The open-vessel rule (v. 1) echoes Numbers 19:15. The red heifer protocol (vv. 7-10) follows Numbers 19:2-5 closely. God speaks throughout as first-person legislator. "Living water" (mayim chayyim) in v. 11 refers to flowing/spring water.*
